config:
[server]
auth_mode = "required"
api_keys = ["client-secret"]
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "m-a"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o"

[catalog]
url = "{UPSTREAM}/catalog?token=cat-query-secret"
timeout = 5
refresh_seconds = 0
headers = { "X-Catalog-Token" = "cat-header-secret" }

[catalog.model_providers]
"cat-only" = "chatup"
name: m4_ops_diagnostics_redacted
